sloka: ममापि पद्मपत्राक्षं सिंहोरस्कं कृशोदरम् ।त्वरते हि मनो द्रष्टुं रामं रमयतां वरम् ।। ७.४६.३१ ॥
transliteration: mamāpi padmapatrākṣaṁ siṁhoraskaṁ kṛśodaram ।tvarate hi mano draṣṭuṁ rāmaṁ ramayatāṁ varam ।। 7.46.31 ॥

translations.english: My mind also indeed yearns to see Rama, who has eyes like lotus leaves, a lion-like chest, a slender belly, and is the best among those who delight others.
